rules.statement: The reopening of a transaction is barred by section 3 of the Money Lending Ordinance if an account was stated six years before the date of the action.
rules.supporting_quote: "Where an account was stated six years before the date of the action, the reopening of that transaction is barred by section 3 of the Money Lending Ordinance."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 3 of the Money Lending Ordinance (Chapter 67)
